_doc: JEV-502 labeled department-routing fixture. Each case is a realistic owner TASK message with the department it belongs to on the standard floor (onboarding 23-ai-workforce-blueprint/department-naming-map.json `mandatory`) and any acceptable alternates. General Task is always acceptable as the safe catch-all and is scored separately (strict vs lenient). Labels were written before any picker was run; never edit a label to fit a picker's output.
